moogs_structures.config.title: Moog's Structures
moogs_structures.config.reload_notice: Changes apply after you reload the world (quit to title and re-enter, or run /reload), and only affect newly generated chunks.
moogs_structures.config.universal_rarity: Multiplies the spacing of every Moog's structure. Higher = rarer, lower = more common.
moogs_structures.config.mod_rarity.toolt: Multiplies the spacing of every %s structure.
moogs_structures.config.preview.unavaila: No preview: this mod hasn't set a preview link (mod_slug).
moogs_structures.cloth_required.title: Moog's Structure Lib
moogs_structures.cloth_required.message: Moog's Structure Lib's config screen requires Cloth Config API. Install it to configure in game.
